intent_dna: Detect control regressions without granting the auditor authority to approve, merge, deploy, or directly rewrite its own policy.
capability_gap: Mailbox learning reports can disagree with actual diffs, remove established controls, introduce unsafe defaults, or omit evidence without a deterministic local audit gate.
proposed_change: Add a read-only ARKAON Audit Bot that binds reports to owner-approved scope, emits sealed PASS/HOLD/BLOCKED manifests, and learns from hash-chained dual-role feedback by generating propose-only upgrade requests.
expected_benefit: Control regressions and report-to-diff mismatches are detected before merge, while repeated verified misses and false positives can produce governed improvement proposals.
risks: Static rules can produce false positives or miss a new unsafe pattern.
Learning feedback could be forged or dominated by one actor.
A PASS could be misread as merge or deployment approval.
validation_plan: Prove protected-control deletion and unbounded resources are BLOCKED.
Prove report/diff mismatch, machine-specific paths, and missing evidence cause HOLD.
Prove owner scope digest mismatch and out-of-scope changes are BLOCKED.
Prove the learning ledger detects tampering and requires ARKAON plus ETERNIAN receipts.
Run full regression and Ruff checks.
